name: ACSF Modules Listing Module
description: Search which modules are enabled across the sites of an Acquia Cloud Site Factory environment, over SSH + drush.
project_description: ACSF modules listing module lets you check the usage of custom and contributed modules across the websites of an Acquia Cloud Site Factory (ACSF) environment. From an admin search form you pick a configured environment and a module name; the module calls the Acquia Cloud API v1 to list the environment's sites, then for each site runs 'drush pm-list' over SSH to collect its enabled modules and reports, per site, which modules match. It helps operators detect which sites use a given module (to plan an upgrade, a security fix, or a cleanup) and optimise performance by finding unnecessary modules. It requires the PHP SSH2 extension, an ACSF API username/key, and an SSH key pair with access to the Acquia Cloud environment. Configuration lives under Configuration -> Web services (cache lifetime) and Structure -> ACSF Environment Entities (one config entity per environment holding SSH and ACSF API credentials).
